ratio_definition: Per ABBA block A0/B1 and A3/B2, then median of all 2*pairs elapsed_us ratios. Ratios above one favor the candidate. Block medians are also retained.

scopes.elapsed_us: Primary: executable internal timer; common setup and result conversion/JSON excluded; allocation and retention of every result included.
scopes.process_wall_seconds: Reference: launch through complete /usr/bin/time child exit, including common setup, result conversion and JSON serialization. Independent Python validation excluded.
scopes.validated_wall_seconds: Process wall plus parsing and complete independent Python output validation; reference derivation and report compression excluded.
scopes.peak_rss_kib: GNU time %M: complete benchmark child process peak RSS, including runtime/setup/inputs/all retained results/conversions/serialization. It is not allocator allocation volume or Python harness RSS.
